scope: independent root audit of endpoint-coordinate freeness, singleton-torus geometry, top-symmetric projective independence, the finite-field degree condition, exact actual gcd overlap, and capacity scope

mathematical_audit.endpoint_coordinate: Item 365 proves that the coefficient of d1 in the endpoint defect is a unit modulo every p dividing b. Solving for d1 leaves the retained row-load coordinates polynomially free over every p^r.
mathematical_audit.singleton_chart: Setting exactly one retained load to zero and localizing all outside loads therefore leaves a full (N-1)-dimensional torus. The sign-chamber units do not change this conclusion.
mathematical_audit.symmetric_coordinates: On that chart T_s/T_1=e_(s-1)(z_1^-1,...,z_(N-1)^-1). Initial elementary symmetric polynomials are algebraically independent, so no nonzero fixed polynomial relation is inherited from the endpoint.
mathematical_audit.finite_field_scope: After substituting a homogeneous degree-d form in the first k coordinates, total degree is at most d(k-1). If this is below p-1, induction in the torus variables proves that its polynomial function is not identically zero. For the tied primes, all listed linear and quadratic Item-381 forms satisfy the condition.
mathematical_audit.actual_gcd: At an actual singleton prime, T1 is the product of all outside unit loads and is a p-unit. Since U_(1,1) is squarefree, its gcd with gcd(T1,...,Tk) is exactly one for every k.
mathematical_audit.logical_boundary: Formal torus freedom does not prove that the unique actual canonical point avoids a moving split line, norm, or conic. Such an actual-point correlation remains an independent arithmetic problem.
mathematical_audit.capacity: The target-forced low-degree mechanism is closed and coordinate-gcd overlap is zero, but no upper bound for U_(1,1) or Gamma_Q follows. Zero mass and zero capacity reduction are booked.
